{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print("Total rows:", len(df))
print("Unique patient_id:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Duplicate patient_id count:", len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check sample_seq for each patient_id to see if higher sample_seq is the latest
sample_seq_max = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
df_with_max_seq = df.merge(sample_seq_max, on='patient_id', suffixes=('', '_max'))
print("Rows with highest sample_seq per patient:", (df_with_max_seq['sample_seq'] == df_with_max_seq['sample_seq_max']).sum())

# Identify patients with multiple sample_seq
multi_sample_patients = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].count().reset_index()
multi_sample_patients = multi_sample_patients[multi_sample_patients['sample_seq'] > 1]
print("Number of patients with multiple sample_seq:", len(multi_sample_patients))

# Show the sample_seq values for one such patient
if not multi_sample_patients.empty:
    test_pid = multi_sample_patients.iloc[0]['patient_id']
    print(f"Sample_seq values for patient {test_pid}:", df[df['patient_id'] == test_pid]['sample_seq'].tolist())"}
